title: Excerpta astrologica: Hermes Trismegistus, al-Kindi (VLO 52)
shelf_note: 17th-c. Leiden manuscript of Latin astrological excerpts (Hermes, al-Kindi); core Hermetic/astrological material. Page 155 is a copied catalogue of the Digby manuscripts given to the Bodleian in 1634, part of the same miscellany.
structure_note: Every image is a full two-page opening (5,596×3,541), and the OCR says it 'covers the right-hand page' only. On p51 and p100 the left-hand page is full text that runs straight into the right page (p100: the left page ends with the catchword 'Una' and the right page begins 'Una natura'). That left-hand text is not in this record's OCR, and with one record per opening (record 155 = folio 149) no other record can hold it. About half the manuscript's text — every verso — looks untranscribed and untranslated (I3, spread not split). pages_translated 154 of 196 OCR'd.

structure_note: Catalogue language is 'Latin', but large parts are English (pp88, 132). 180 pages, 174 translated; nothing broken in the sample.
